response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile full-stack and systems engineer with broad experience across web, mobile, and infrastructure, but he does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role: he lacks the required 8 years of C++ programming (only brief C/C++ work at National Instruments and a bachelor thesis project) and has no demonstrated large-scale cloud compute platform or distributed infrastructure leadership experience. His background is heavily skewed toward web/product engineering (TypeScript, Node.js, Ember) rather than C++ systems/infrastructure work, making him a poor fit despite his seniority and mentoring inclinations.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level experience across many companies and domains
Demonstrated mentoring and knowledge-sharing through workshops, talks, and open-source projects
Experience with distributed/high-throughput systems at Dunnhumby (micro-services, low-latency DLang apps)
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (~6 months at National Instruments plus a student project) versus the required 8 years
No evidence of large-scale cloud compute platform ownership or production cloud architecture leadership
Career trajectory is generalist/full-stack rather than infrastructure/distributed-systems specialist, with no formal 'technical lead' title

key_factors.factor: No large-scale cloud compute/infrastructure leadership track record
Strong mentoring, TDD, and cross-team leadership habits
